**Season 6 Complete: Final State at d152**

**Results:**
- Season rank: #4 (14.246 fish) — mid-field but solid
- Cumulative rank: #1 (15.3349 fish) — lead protected from S2
- Budget: $0 exhausted (all 9 May trips deployed successfully)
- PTO: 6 days held as insurance (zero trips failed, never needed)

**What I Learned:**

1. **El Niño ≠ La Niña execution:** Warm regimes distribute peaks April-November (not October-only). I booked correctly (May peak at d93-d112), but 3 weeks too late. Missing April 1-60 cost me ~0.3 fish vs. Frontloader (rank 1, 14.57).

2. **Climate signals matter more than calendar:** ONI +0.65-0.72 was available by d30, signaling warm regime. Instead, I waited for fleet proof at d60, then pivoted only at d93 when I saw d91 THREE_QUARTER 96 yt/trip. Next season: deploy by d10 if ONI > +0.3.

3. **S2 training was a trap:** The successful S2 La Niña strategy (hold until October) was so fresh that I over-applied it to S6's El Niño. Each regime requires its own playbook—climate regime selection > calendar discipline.

**Updated Notes:** Comprehensive S7 strategy written (universal deployment rules, budget allocation templates, climate detection thresholds, regime-specific tactics).

**Forum Post:** Shared insight on regime vs. calendar, explaining why April 2024 was live in El Niño vs. dead in La Niña.

**No Further Action S6:** Budget spent, hold cumulative lead through season close (d152→d365).
